new_facts.fact: Fall meal plans end with the fall semester and cannot be carried into winter break; students can use BRBs at open dining rooms and retail spots; Cornell Dining traditionally closes everything during the week the university is closed, when City Bucks can be used at open local establishments
new_facts.value: Meal plans end at fall close; BRBs during break; City Bucks during closed week
new_facts.source_title: Winter Break Housing, Cornell Student & Campus Life

new_facts.fact: Eligibility: must be returning as a student to on-campus housing for spring semester; non-residents of open buildings get Residential Flex Spaces, extremely limited, full break only ($500); fees flat and not prorated; Veterans House free (in academic-year license); HILC and Loving House free thanks to individual gifts; new students select a Winter Break Housing option on housing application
new_facts.value: Returning to on-campus housing in spring
new_facts.source_title: Winter Break Housing, Cornell Student & Campus Life

new_facts.fact: Requests for later departure than 2 p.m. Dec. 20 due in Housing and Dining Portal by Monday, Dec. 7; $60.00 per hour or fraction after; residences reopen 9 a.m. Tue Jan. 19, 2027; classes begin Tue Jan. 26
new_facts.source_title: Winter Break 2026 Closing Checklist, Cornell Student & Campus Life

new_facts.fact: Hasbrouck Apartments 12-month contract rents, per month: studio $1,355; 1BR $1,415-$1,490; regular single in 2BR townhouse $620; large single $910; 2BR 3rd floor $1,500; 2BR townhouse $1,475-$1,530
new_facts.source_title: Housing Rates, Cornell Student & Campus Life

new_facts.fact: Global Cornell invites international students concerned that visa issues limit travel home during breaks to email housing@cornell.edu in confidence about on-campus housing
new_facts.source_title: Immigration Advice and Resources, Cornell Global
